manaNeeded: {W} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
notablePrerequisites: Magnanimous Magistrate has at least one reprieve counter on it.
description:
Cast Mikaeus either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Mikaeus enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Metstatic Evangel and Magnanimous Magistrate trigger.
Resolve the Metastatic Evangel trigger, putting a reprieve counter on Magnanimous Magistrate.
Resolve the Magnanimous Magistrate trigger, removing a reprieve counter from it and returning Mikaeus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat
